```{r cars,fig.width=16,fig.height=15}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
rm(list=ls())
setwd("~/Desktop/codes")
dat <- read_excel("~/Desktop/codes/data/Ex_Fig2_data.xlsx", sheet = "metals")

# Molar mass (g/mol), used to convert measured mg/L -> mol/L
molar_mass <- c(Cu = 63.546, Fe = 55.845, Mn = 54.938)

# Generic plotting function
# dat: data frame, m: metal name, xvar: x-axis variable name, yvar: y-axis variable name
# xlab: x-axis label, ylab: y-axis label, tag: subplot tag (a, b, c, ...)
plot_metal <- function(dat, m, xvar, yvar, xlab, ylab, tag) {
  M <- molar_mass[[m]]
  meas <- m
  pred <- paste0(m, "_con")
  
  # Data processing
  d <- dat %>%
    select(Nlevel, pH, measured = all_of(meas), predicted = all_of(pred)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(measured), !is.na(predicted), measured > 0, predicted > 0) %>%
    mutate(
      Nlevel = as.numeric(Nlevel),
      measured_molL = measured / (1000 * M),
      log10_measured = log10(measured_molL),
      log10_predicted = log10(predicted)
    )
  
  # Extract x and y vectors to compute Spearman correlation
  x_vec <- d[[xvar]]
  y_vec <- d[[yvar]]
  
  ct <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(x_vec, y_vec, method = "spearman"))
  rho_val <- round(unname(ct$estimate), 3)
  p_raw   <- ct$p.value
  
  # ===== Handle p-value =====
  # If p underflows to 0 (or is below machine precision), report "p < 2.2e-16"
  # instead of the misleading "p = 0.00e+00".
  if (p_raw == 0 || p_raw < .Machine$double.eps) {
    p_expr <- 'italic(p) < "2.2e-16"'
  } else {
    p_expr <- paste0('italic(p) == "', sprintf("%.2e", p_raw), '"')
  }
  
  # plotmath expression: italic rho and italic p on two rows
  lab <- paste0("atop(italic(rho) == ", rho_val, ", ", p_expr, ")")
  
  # Get data range to anchor the statistics label at the bottom-right corner
  x_max <- max(x_vec, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_min <- min(y_vec, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  ggplot(d, aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]], color = pH)) +
    geom_point(size = 6.5, alpha = 1) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
    scale_color_viridis_c(option = "A", name = "pH") +
    annotate("text",
             x = x_max, y = y_min,
             label = lab,
             parse = TRUE,          # ← 解析 plotmath 表达式
             hjust = 1, vjust = 0,
             size = 6.5,            # ← 统计标签字号（原 4.5）
             fontface = "bold") +
    labs(x = xlab, y = ylab, tag = tag) + # add tag here
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      axis.title = element_text(color = "black", face = "bold", size = 13),
      axis.text  = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
      panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 1.5, linetype = "solid"),
      plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 22) # enlarged bold tag
    )
}

# Shared x-axis label
xlab_n <- bquote(bold(N~addition~levels~(g~N~m^-2~yr^-1)))

# Generate 9 plots, strictly following row order: Fe, Mn, Cu

# --- First row: Fe ---
p_a <- plot_metal(dat, "Fe", "Nlevel", "log10_measured", xlab_n, "log10 measured Fe (mol/L, by ICP)", "a")
p_d <- plot_metal(dat, "Fe", "Nlevel", "log10_predicted", xlab_n, "log10 predicted Fe (mol/L, by Visual MINTEQ)", "d")
p_g <- plot_metal(dat, "Fe", "log10_measured", "log10_predicted", "log10 measured Fe (mol/L, by ICP)", "log10 predicted Fe (mol/L, by Visual MINTEQ)", "g")

# --- Second row: Mn ---
p_b <- plot_metal(dat, "Mn", "Nlevel", "log10_measured", xlab_n, "log10 measured Mn (mol/L, by ICP)", "b")
p_e <- plot_metal(dat, "Mn", "Nlevel", "log10_predicted", xlab_n, "log10 predicted Mn (mol/L, by Visual MINTEQ)", "e")
p_h <- plot_metal(dat, "Mn", "log10_measured", "log10_predicted", "log10 measured Mn (mol/L, by ICP)", "log10 predicted Mn (mol/L, by Visual MINTEQ)", "h")

# --- Third row: Cu ---
p_c <- plot_metal(dat, "Cu", "Nlevel", "log10_measured", xlab_n, "log10 measured Cu (mol/L, by ICP)", "c")
p_f <- plot_metal(dat, "Cu", "Nlevel", "log10_predicted", xlab_n, "log10 predicted Cu (mol/L, by Visual MINTEQ)", "f")
p_i <- plot_metal(dat, "Cu", "log10_measured", "log10_predicted", "log10 measured Cu (mol/L, by ICP)", "log10 predicted Cu (mol/L, by Visual MINTEQ)", "i")

# Combine by column (vertical stacking /)
col1 <- p_a / p_b / p_c  # First column (a, b, c)
col2 <- p_d / p_e / p_f  # Second column (d, e, f)
col3 <- p_g / p_h / p_i  # Third column (g, h, i)

# Merge the three columns horizontally (horizontal |)
combined <- (col1 | col2 | col3) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(
    # Place legend at the bottom, positioned lower
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    # Increase legend font size
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 15),
    # Push legend lower: reduce bottom margin and increase top spacing
    legend.margin = margin(t = 5, r = 10, b = 0, l = 10),
    legend.box.spacing = unit(0.3, "cm"),
    # Adjust overall margins to give the legend more space
    plot.margin = margin(t = 5, r = 10, b = 5, l = 10)
  )
print(combined)
# Save figure (increase height appropriately to leave room for the bottom legend)
ggsave("~/Desktop/codes/figures/Ex_Fig2a-i.pdf", combined, width = 16, height = 15, dpi = 300)
```

```{r,fig.width=6,fig.height=15}
rm(list=ls())
setwd("~/Desktop/codes")
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggthemes)
library(ggtext)   # ★ 用于渲染 y 轴下标

plot_data1 <- read_excel("~/Desktop/codes/data/Ex_Fig2_data.xlsx", sheet = "femncu")
plot_data1[is.na(plot_data1)] <- ""
plot_data1 <- plot_data1 %>% filter(group %in% c("Fe", "Mn", "Cu"))

custom_colors <- c("N50cont" = "red", "N50cess" = "blue")
plot_data <- plot_data1

plot_data$significant <- ifelse(plot_data$pval < 0.05, "Significant", "Non-significant")
plot_data$fill_color <- ifelse(plot_data$significant == "Significant",
                               custom_colors[plot_data$Subgroup],
                               "white")
plot_data$point_shape <- ifelse(plot_data$significant == "Significant", 16, 21)
plot_data$Subgroup <- factor(plot_data$Subgroup, levels = c("YN50", "NN50"))
plot_data$Subgroup <- factor(plot_data$Subgroup, labels = c("N50cont", "N50cess"))

plot_data$group <- factor(plot_data$group, levels = c("Fe", "Mn", "Cu"))
plot_data$group <- factor(plot_data$group,
                          labels = c("Available Fe",
                                     "Available Mn",
                                     "Available Cu"))

# p label as plotmath expression
plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(
    label_x = estimate,
    label_y = as.numeric(Subgroup) + 0.15,
    p_label = ifelse(pval < 0.001,
                     paste0("italic(p) == \"", sprintf("%.1e", pval), "\""),
                     paste0("italic(p) == \"", as.character(signif(pval, 3)), "\""))
  )

p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = estimate, y = Subgroup)) +
  facet_wrap(.~group, ncol = 1) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmax = estimate + 1.96 * se,
                     xmin = estimate - 1.96 * se,
                     color = Subgroup,
                     linetype = "95% CI"),
                 size = 2, height = 0, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmax = estimate + se,
                     xmin = estimate - se,
                     color = Subgroup,
                     linetype = "±SE"),      
                 size = 3.5, height = 0, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = fill_color, color = Subgroup, shape = significant),
             size = 11, stroke = 1.8, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(x = label_x, y = label_y, label = p_label, color = Subgroup),
            size = 6.5, hjust = 0.42, vjust = 0.1, fontface = "bold",
            parse = TRUE,
            show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = custom_colors, name = "Treatment") +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  scale_y_discrete(
    labels = c("N50<sub>cont</sub>",
               "N50<sub>cess</sub>")
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(name = "Significance",
                     values = c("Significant" = 16, "Non-significant" = 21),
                     labels = c("Significant" = "p < 0.05",
                                "Non-significant" = "p > 0.05")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(name = "Error bars",
                        values = c("95% CI" = "solid", "±SE" = "solid"),  
                        guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(
                          size = c(2, 3.5),
                          alpha = c(0.4, 0.7),
                          color = "black"))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "gray", linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5) +
  labs(x = 'Effect size of nitrogen addition (LRR)',
       y = '',
       title = " ") +
  theme_few() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, color = "black", face = "bold"),
    # ★ 修改点 1：将 y 轴标签（N50cont / N50cess）字体放大（12 -> 16）
    axis.text.y = element_markdown(size = 16, color = "black", face = "bold"),
    title = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    # ★ 修改点 2：将 y 轴真实标题（title）放大（16 -> 20，虽然目前 title 是空的）
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"), 
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 18, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10),
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black", size = 1.5, linetype = "solid"),
    panel.spacing.y = unit(1.0, "cm")
  )
print(p)
ggsave("~/Desktop/codes/figures/Ex_Fig2jkl.pdf", width = 6, height = 15, dpi = 300)
```

```{r,fig.width=5,fig.height=14}
rm(list = ls())
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggsignif)
library(tibble)
library(patchwork)   # for combining plots vertically
library(readxl)
library(ggtext)      # ★ 新增：用于渲染 x 轴的下标
setwd("~/Desktop/codes")

# 颜色：正红 / 正蓝
col_blue <- "blue"
col_red  <- "red"
col_ctrl <- "#c4c4c4"

# ---------- General plotting function ----------
plot_amcc <- function(metric, ylab_text, title_text, out_csv = NULL) {
  
  df <- read_excel("~/Desktop/codes/data/Ex_fig2_data.xlsx", sheet = "mrg")
  
  # Recode TR: YN50 -> N50cont, NN50 -> N50cess, N0 -> Control
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(TR = case_when(
      TR == "YN50" ~ "N50cont",
      TR == "NN50" ~ "N50cess",
      TR == "N0"   ~ "Control"
    )) %>%
    drop_na(all_of(metric))
  
  # Factor order: Control -> N50cess -> N50cont
  df$TR <- factor(df$TR, levels = c("Control", "N50cess", "N50cont"))
  
  # Sample size per group
  cat("\n======== ", metric, " sample counts per group ========\n")
  print(table(df$TR))
  
  # Extract values per group
  Control <- df %>% filter(TR == "Control") %>% pull(all_of(metric))
  N50cess <- df %>% filter(TR == "N50cess") %>% pull(all_of(metric))
  N50cont <- df %>% filter(TR == "N50cont") %>% pull(all_of(metric))
  
  # ---------- 1. Welch's t-test (planned comparisons) ----------
  t1 <- t.test(N50cess, Control, var.equal = FALSE)
  t2 <- t.test(N50cont, Control, var.equal = FALSE)
  
  p_raw <- c(t1$p.value, t2$p.value)
  
  cat("\n--- ", metric, " Welch's t-test (uncorrected, planned comparisons) ---\n")
  cat("N50cess vs Control: t =", round(t1$statistic, 3),
      " df =", round(t1$parameter, 2),
      " p =", p_raw[1], "\n")
  cat("N50cont vs Control: t =", round(t2$statistic, 3),
      " df =", round(t2$parameter, 2),
      " p =", p_raw[2], "\n")
  
  # ---------- 2. Annotation text (bold italic t and p, bold values) ----------
  annot_text <- c(
    sprintf("bolditalic(t) == bold('%.2f') * ',' ~ bolditalic(p) == bold('%.3f')",
            t1$statistic, p_raw[1]),
    sprintf("bolditalic(t) == bold('%.2f') * ',' ~ bolditalic(p) == bold('%.3f')",
            t2$statistic, p_raw[2])
  )
  
  # ---------- 3. Bracket positions based on data range ----------
  y_max   <- max(df[[metric]], na.rm = TRUE)
  y_min   <- min(df[[metric]], na.rm = TRUE)
  y_range <- y_max - y_min
  
  bracket_y1 <- y_max + y_range * 0.10   # lower bracket (Control vs N50cess)
  bracket_y2 <- y_max + y_range * 0.30   # upper bracket (Control vs N50cont)
  y_top      <- y_max + y_range * 0.65   # 为放大的标签留白
  
  # ---------- 4. Plot ----------
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = TR, y = .data[[metric]], fill = TR)) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3,
                 alpha = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_point(aes(color = TR),
               size = 5.5, alpha = 0.5,
               position = position_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0, seed = 1),
               show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      name = "Treatment",
      values = c(
        "Control" = col_ctrl,
        "N50cess" = col_blue,
        "N50cont" = col_red
      )
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      name = "Treatment",
      values = c(
        "Control" = col_ctrl,
        "N50cess" = col_blue,
        "N50cont" = col_red
      )
    ) +
    # ★ x 轴标签改为带下标的 HTML 格式
    scale_x_discrete(
      labels = c("Control",
                 "N50<sub>cess</sub>",
                 "N50<sub>cont</sub>")
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(NA, y_top),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.02))
    ) +
    xlab(" ") +
    ylab(ylab_text) +
    ggtitle(title_text) +
    # ★ 第一次 geom_signif：Control vs N50cess（正蓝）
    ggsignif::geom_signif(
      comparisons     = list(c("Control", "N50cess")),
      annotations     = annot_text[1],
      y_position      = bracket_y1,
      step_increase   = 0,
      tip_length      = 0.015,
      vjust           = -0.25,
      textsize        = 5.5,
      parse           = TRUE,
      map_signif_level = FALSE,
      color           = col_blue
    ) +
    # ★ 第二次 geom_signif：Control vs N50cont（正红）
    ggsignif::geom_signif(
      comparisons     = list(c("Control", "N50cont")),
      annotations     = annot_text[2],
      y_position      = bracket_y2,
      step_increase   = 0,
      tip_length      = 0.015,
      vjust           = -0.25,
      textsize        = 5.5,
      parse           = TRUE,
      map_signif_level = FALSE,
      color           = col_red
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      text = element_text(size = 16, family = "sans"),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
      # ★ 拆分 axis.text：x 轴用 element_markdown 渲染下标
      axis.text.x = element_markdown(colour = "black", size = 18, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "black", size = 16, face = "bold"),
      axis.title = element_text(colour = "black", size = 16, face = "bold"),
      panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black", size = 1.5, linetype = "solid"),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
  
  # ---------- 5. Optional CSV of statistical results ----------
  if (!is.null(out_csv)) {
    stat_res <- tibble(
      comparison    = c("N50cess vs Control", "N50cont vs Control"),
      group1        = c("N50cess", "N50cont"),
      group2        = c("Control", "Control"),
      n_group1      = c(length(N50cess), length(N50cont)),
      n_group2      = c(length(Control), length(Control)),
      mean_group1   = c(mean(N50cess, na.rm = TRUE), mean(N50cont, na.rm = TRUE)),
      mean_group2   = c(mean(Control, na.rm = TRUE), mean(Control, na.rm = TRUE)),
      sd_group1     = c(sd(N50cess, na.rm = TRUE), sd(N50cont, na.rm = TRUE)),
      sd_group2     = c(sd(Control, na.rm = TRUE), sd(Control, na.rm = TRUE)),
      t_statistic   = c(as.numeric(t1$statistic), as.numeric(t2$statistic)),
      df            = c(as.numeric(t1$parameter), as.numeric(t2$parameter)),
      p_value       = p_raw,
      test_method   = "Welch's t-test (uncorrected, planned comparisons)"
    )
    write.csv(stat_res, out_csv, row.names = FALSE)
  }
  
  return(p)
}

# ============================================================
#  Build the three panels
# ============================================================
p_cu <- plot_amcc(
  metric     = "cu_amcc",
  ylab_text  = "Relative abundance of AMCC-Cu (×/Gb)",
  title_text = "ARG-MRG (Cu) co-located contigs (AMCC-Cu)",
  out_csv    = "~/Desktop/codes/tables/fig2m_Cu_AMCC_WelchT_stat_result.csv"
)

p_mn <- plot_amcc(
  metric     = "mn_amcc",
  ylab_text  = "Relative abundance of AMCC-Mn (×/Gb)",
  title_text = "ARG-MRG (Mn) co-located contigs (AMCC-Mn)",
  out_csv    = "~/Desktop/codes/tables/ex_fig2n_Mn_AMCC_WelchT_stat_result.csv"
)

p_fe <- plot_amcc(
  metric     = "fe_amcc",
  ylab_text  = "Relative abundance of AMCC-Fe (×/Gb)",
  title_text = "ARG-MRG (Fe) co-located contigs (AMCC-Fe)",
  out_csv    = "~/Desktop/codes/tables/ex_fig2o_Fe_AMCC_WelchT_stat_result.csv"
)

# ============================================================
#  Merge the three plots vertically (no a/b/c tags)
# ============================================================
combined <- p_cu / p_mn / p_fe

print(combined)

# ============================================================
#  Export the combined figure (saved under codes/figures/)
# ============================================================
ggsave("~/Desktop/codes/figures/Ex_Fig2mno.pdf",
       combined, width = 5, height = 14, dpi = 300)

# View statistical results
read.csv("~/Desktop/codes/tables/Ex_Fig2o_Fe_AMCC_WelchT_stat_result.csv")
```
